cues.en: Piecewise functions are pretty straightforward, but they come up often enough in calculus and applied math, including, for example, activation functions in deep learning.
cues.zh: 分段函數很直接，但在微積分與應用數學經常出現，例如深度學習的激活函數。

cues.en: And so in this video, you will learn what it means for a function to be piecewise and also the notation of piecewise functions.
cues.zh: 這支會學到分段函數的含義與記號。

cues.en: So what is a piecewise function?
cues.zh: 什麼是分段函數？

cues.en: Well, it's just a function that comes in multiple pieces.
cues.zh: 就是由多個片段組成的函數。

cues.en: Basically, the idea is that you have several distinct functions for different subdomains.
cues.zh: 基本上，不同子定義域有不同的函數。

cues.en: Piecewise functions are typically described using this kind of aid notation.
cues.zh: 通常用這種記號表示。

cues.en: So these are called the cases.
cues.zh: 這些叫 cases，各種情況。

cues.en: And the idea is that each row provides a case or a piece of the function.
cues.zh: 每一列提供一種情況、函數的一個片段。

cues.en: And then there are two columns in here.
cues.zh: 裡面有兩欄。

cues.en: The first column describes the function itself, and the second column defines the domain for that piece of the function.
cues.zh: 第一欄描述函數本身，第二欄定義該片段的定義域。

cues.en: Now, the exact formatting is variable.
cues.zh: 精確格式可以不同。

cues.en: Sometimes you'll see people write for or when instead of if.
cues.zh: 有時用 for 或 when，不用 if。

cues.en: Sometimes there's no word here, just a comma, sometimes also just a space.
cues.zh: 有時不寫字，只有逗號，或只有空白。

cues.en: Sometimes people put a period or a comma at the ends of the lines.
cues.zh: 有時每行結尾放句點或逗號。

cues.en: Here, that all doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 都不重要。

cues.en: The important thing is that each row defines a piece of the function, and the first column is the function rule, and the second column is the subdomain.
cues.zh: 重要的是每列定義一個片段，第一欄是規則，第二欄是子定義域。

cues.en: That's the important part.
cues.zh: 這才重要。

cues.en: So here you see a graph of this piecewise function.
cues.zh: 這裡是這個分段函數的圖。

cues.en: Again, pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 同樣很直接。

cues.en: You just have to be mindful of the exact definitions of the subdomain and in particular whether each piece is inclusive or exclusive.
cues.zh: 只要留意子定義域的精確定義，尤其是否包含端點。

cues.en: And here I've highlighted with colors, so you can see how the definition of this piecewise function maps onto these different components of the graph.
cues.zh: 這裡用顏色標出，能看到定義如何對應圖形各部分。

cues.en: Here's another example.
cues.zh: 再一個例子。

cues.en: I would like you to pause the video, ponder this definition of this piecewise function, and see if you recognize it.
cues.zh: 請暫停，想想這個分段函數定義，看看認不認得。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Have you figured it out yet?
cues.zh: 想出來了嗎？

cues.en: It is actually the absolute value function.
cues.zh: 其實是絕對值函數。

cues.en: Well, so this is one way to define the absolute value.
cues.zh: 這是定義絕對值的一種方式。

cues.en: You can also express the absolute value function as the principal square root of the number squared.
cues.zh: 也能表示成，數字平方之後的主平方根。

cues.en: But many times in mathematics, you can arrive at the same conclusion or the same mathematical object
cues.zh: 數學裡經常能透過不同方式，得到相同結論、相同數學物件，

cues.en: in different ways, and you'll see that theme come up over and over again throughout the course, particularly when we start getting to proofs of various derivatives.
cues.zh: 課程會不斷看到這主題，尤其開始證明各種導數時。

cues.en: Okay, here again is the highlighted colors, just so you can confirm what you have already figured out.
cues.zh: 這裡再用顏色標出，確認你已想出的答案。

cues.en: One more example.
cues.zh: 再一個。

cues.en: This is actually a really important piecewise function.
cues.zh: 這是很重要的分段函數。

cues.en: It's used in deep learning.
cues.zh: 用於深度學習。

cues.en: It's called Réélu, which stands for rectified linear unit.
cues.zh: 叫 ReLU，代表 Rectified Linear Unit，整流線性單元。

cues.en: And the function basically just inserts a non linearity into deep learning models that allow the models to learn these really impressively complex mappings.
cues.zh: 基本上是在深度學習模型加入非線性，讓模型能學習極為複雜的映射。

cues.en: And also, what I would like you to notice here is that each of these two pieces is individually linear.
cues.zh: 也請注意，這兩個片段各自都是線性的。

cues.en: So this is a linear function, this is a linear function, but the entire function itself is non linear, even though it comprises linear pieces.
cues.zh: 這是線性，那也是線性，但整個函數非線性，即使由線性片段組成。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Piecewise function is a function that comprises multiple different functions for different domains of
cues.zh: 分段函數，是針對不同 x 定義域，由不同函數，

cues.en: X, and it's described using the cases notation with one row per sub function and subdomain.
cues.zh: 組成，用 cases 記號描述，每個子函數與子定義域各占一列。
